design: the study design's splits, with the two-year emission tests and the climatological-emission folds
validation_rule: every day of each ISO week whose number is divisible by 5 (datetime.date.isocalendar)
index_rule: index into the year's arrays: days since January 1 of that year

2019.label: forward test; under C-7a the main set's inputs carry each year's own emissions, the climatological-emission folds' emission climatology

arms.TRUE: emis_true_2017.npy for the training days and emis_true_2019.npy for the test days
arms.OTHER: each year the emission climatology of the other year: the training days take emis_clim_2019.npy, the test days emis_clim_2017.npy
arms.OWN: each year its own emission climatology: the training days take emis_clim_2017.npy, the test days emis_clim_2019.npy
